criteria.description: Workbook opens and contains PO_Header, Base_Schedule, Revised_Schedule, Revision_Log, Provenance, and Checks.
The supplied base schedule remains intact with correct line IDs, descriptions, quantities, prices, and units.
The revised schedule contains every base line plus the insertion and applies each listed addendum change to the correct supplied line ID.
The protected unlisted PO-04 row remains unchanged in the revised schedule.
Every revised line total and at least one visibly identified revised-schedule total are formula-linked and evaluate correctly.

Both manifest-selected revised-schedule changes—a quantity and a distinct unit price—update the affected line and every declared revised total while preserving unrelated and protected rows; duplicate total cells are not required.
The revision log records each changed/inserted line with semantically correct change type and before/after evidence; concise labels such as Quantity or Unit price are accepted.
Each changed supplied line ID links once to the correct addendum file/page with a candidate-readable locator.
Revised IDs are unique and the revised, log, and provenance populations are complete without duplicates.
Penalty for contradictory source-file or addendum-page claims in provenance.

review_notes.purpose_zh: 检查是否只应用三项变更、保留其他采购行和原 ID、记录修订来源，并得到正确总额。
review_notes.answer_location_zh: 按表头别名、行内容、项目 ID 和变更记录查找修订表，不要求参考答案的固定措辞。
accepted_equivalents_zh: Quantity 和数量等近义表头
只出现一次的清楚总额
review_notes.not_scoreable_zh: 无法将修订行与原始项目 ID 对应，或同一项目有多个相互矛盾的最终值时，应先记录识别问题。
review_notes.known_limit_zh: 公式要求和关键总额的替代摆放位置还要用真实答卷继续核对。
review_notes.reporting_zh: 当前对外只使用 0 至 1 的连续分数和分项结果；hurdle_criteria 和 pass_threshold 仅为旧运行接口保留。
